rigidAxioms: GameConfig SSOT: All gameplay data driven by config; zero hardcoded magic numbers (WKG-CFG-001).
Unidirectional view snapshots: View layer only consumes immutable snapshots (apply_snapshot) (WKG-VUE-001).
Zero heap allocation in loops: Zero object instantiation or string concatenation in hot frames (ADV-PRF-002).
Decoupled pure logic: Keep rules & data structures pure for headless test execution.
Four-stage pipeline: Strictly follow Clarify -> Design -> Construct -> Regression workflow.
MOD SDK contract: Preserve MOD SDK extension points, API contracts, and serialization format.
Rule catalog closure: Register new rules in rule catalog; zero rule drift (RCFG-RULE-DRIFT).
